sections.label: Legal system trust and accessibility
sections.summary: Singapore will steward legal reforms and join the Hague Service Convention to improve service of documents abroad in civil and commercial matters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will press on with efforts to enhance trust and relevance, and improve accessibility of our legal system.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will proactively steward legal reforms to meet evolving societal needs, while ensuring that our processes are up-to-date, efficient, and effective, such as by becoming a Party to the Hague Service Convention, which can help Singapore litigants with the effective service abroad of judicial and extrajudicial documents in civil and commercial matters.

sections.label: Public Defender's Office establishment
sections.summary: The Public Defender's Office was established in end-2022, with criminal defence aid expanded to the bottom 35% of households and most offences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The establishment of the Public Defender’s Office (PDO) in end-2022, together with the expansion of coverage for criminal defence aid to the bottom 35% of households and covering most offences, was a significant milestone in our legal landscape.

sections.label: Community Dispute Management Framework
sections.summary: Singapore will mandate mediation for certain neighbour disputes and enhance proceedings in the Community Disputes Resolution Tribunals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We are working with the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth and the Ministry of National Development to enhance the Community Dispute Management Framework.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will be mandating mediation for certain types of disputes between neighbours and enhancing the effectiveness of proceedings in the Community Disputes Resolution Tribunals.

sections.label: Intangible Assets disclosure and services
sections.summary: An Intangibles Disclosure Framework will be introduced and an online platform set up to give companies better access to IA/IP services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: To support the development and use of Intangible Assets (IA) to create economic and business value, we will introduce the Intangibles Disclosure Framework to provide a consistent basis for businesses to disclose and communicate details of their intangibles and set up an enterprise-centric online platform to provide companies with better access to professional IA/IP services.

sections.label: State properties and digital conveyancing
sections.summary: Singapore will maximise state property value through partnerships and rejuvenation projects, and the Singapore Land Authority is developing a Digital Conveyancing Portal.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will continue to maximise the potential and unlock the value of state properties, to meet Singapore’s social and economic objectives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will pursue partnerships with stakeholders, experts and the public, such as the rejuvenation of Gillman Barracks, Yarrow Gardens, and Dempsey, to harness innovative ideas and business models and realise the potential value of our limited land and space.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Singapore Land Authority is developing the Digital Conveyancing Portal (DCP), following engagements with multiple stakeholders, including the Housing and Development Board, Urban Redevelopment Authority and other stakeholders involved in the conveyancing process, like real estate developers, conveyancing lawyers and law clerks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: It aims to transform the current paper-based conveyancing process into a fully integrated and paperless one.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will continue engaging stakeholders and taking in feedback across the development phases to co-deliver a DCP that best meets the needs of the public and industry.
